in_sanskrit.name: Konkana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'kun' which means 'bend' or 'curve'. The name can be interpreted as one who is bent or curved in nature.

in_marathi.name: Kongu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kongu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Tamil language, meaning 'Little One' or 'Infant'. In Hindu mythology, Kongu is an alternative name for Lord Shiva, particularly in the southern regions of India.

in_bengali.name: Kongu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kongu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Tamil language, meaning 'Little One' or 'Infant'. In Hindu mythology, Kongu is an alternative name for Lord Shiva, particularly in the southern regions of India.
